Department Marketing Statement

Established in 1970, the Environmental Studies Program at UC Santa Barbara is one of the oldest and largest programs of its kind, with more than 1,100 current majors and over 7,500 alumni. The program has a longstanding commitment to interdisciplinary research and teaching, and a balance among the biophysical sciences, social sciences, humanities, and applied professions. UC Santa Barbara is a Hispanic Serving Institution, and more than 40 percent of our undergraduates are first-generation college students. The department has 17 faculty, 26 lecturers, and 6 full-time support staff; the program is housed in the triple-platinum LEED green building, Bren Hall.

Benefits Of Belonging

Working at UC means being part of this vibrant institution that shines a light on what is possible. People make UC great, and UC recognizes your contributions by making this a great place to work. Excellent retirement and health are just one of the rewards. Learn more about the benefits of working at UC

Brief Summary Of Job Duties

Under the general supervision of the Business Officer and Dept Chair, the Program Assistant & IPEES Coordinator is a multi-tasking team player who performs a wide variety of administrative duties to support and streamline the Environmental Studies Program. This position: Provides excellent customer service to all faculty, staff, students, and department visitors. Coordinates the Interdepartmental PhD Emphasis in Environment & Society (IPEES) program, as well as the newly developing partnership with the Bren School for the collaborative PhD initiative. Coordinates the department's internal scholarships/awards application and award notification process. Provides basic-level web/technology/marketing-related support to staff and faculty, and coordinates with our UCSB IT Department on department instructional needs. Collects faculty/student news for the annual ES Newsletter and works with the Department Chair on designing the content. Manages day-to-day front desk operations, which may include: DSP exams, instructor and teaching assistant office schedule/key assignments, general office supply orders, course evaluation coordination, and assists with daily facility needs to help facilitate a welcoming and supportive environment for our program's faculty, students and staff.

Required Qualifications

High School Diploma
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with all levels of staff, students, and faculty verbally and in writing.
Requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple tasks with frequent interruptions.
Ability to exercise sound judgement, common sense, and discretion, when attending to issues and concerns.
Ability to work effectively and cooperatively as a team member.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree
1-3 years Work in an Academic or Administrative Office Setting

Note: 25% of this 100% full-time job is funded on an annual basis via IPEES Funding, with plans to renew and continue each fiscal year.
Satisfactory criminal history background check
UCSB is a Tobacco-Free environment

As a condition of employment, the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.

Job Functions And Percentages Of Time

45% General ES Undergraduate Program & Instructional Support - Acts as the initial contact for students, visitors, and faculty. Provides coverage of main phone line and front desk. Coordinates the department’s scholarship application cycle, faculty Awards Committee scheduling, and award notification process. Orders and maintains inventory of office supplies and departmental equipment and technology. Distributes office mail, processes deliveries, coordinates mailbox assignments. Updates office hours schedule, keys, and coordinates event room reservations. Assigns temporary lecturer and teaching assistant office space, and assists the Business Officer with departmental space management and faculty office onboarding and renovations. Updates various databases and the Program Coordinator desk manual, as needed. Supervises and trains 1 - 2 Student Assistants to help with the administrative tasks. Coordinates DSP exam accommodations by working with instructors and the Disabled Students Program. Stays up-to-date with existing DSP/ADA campus policies in order to provide accommodation recommendations to instructors when needed. Processes course materials by submitting textbook/course materials adoptions to the bookstore and coordinating desk copy requests from publishers for instructors and teaching assistants. Manages departmental course reserves and works closely with library staff to ensure reserves are available to students. Coordinates quarterly course evaluations for instructors and teaching assistants, and provides data on ESCI reports for the Business Officer and Chair to review if needed; maintains course evaluation files and records. Maintains supplies and tracks inventory for Environmental Studies Chemistry lab. Orders parking permits for instructors' course guest lecturers. Coordinates with LSIT Department to help support IT/AV equipment for courses in departmental classrooms (Bren 4016 and Bren 4316). Serves as the liaison between faculty and Instructional Development, the campus bookstore, the University Library, the Disabled Students Program, Facilities Management, and LSIT, etc. Provides assistance on other special projects as assigned by the Department Chair.
25% Interdepartmental PhD Emphasis and Bren PhD MOU Coordination - Interdepartmental PhD Emphasis and Bren PhD MOU Coordination - Coordinates the Interdepartmental PhD Emphasis in Environment & Society (IPEES) program, as well as the newly developing partnership with the Bren School for a collaborative PhD initiative. Organizes annual Student Symposium and assists with coordinating the event’s budget. Recruits students/faculty committee members in other departments through flyers and email marketing. Maintains all student records and tracks student progress. Provides basic student advising on the PhD emphasis track. Updates all IPEES webpage information.
15% Events/ Website / Marketing Assistance - Leads the planning, management, and execution of departmental events, including the annual Environmental Studies Commencement Celebration and Senior Awards Ceremony, the annual Steven Manley Memorial Lecture, the annual Darcy Aston Lecture, the annual Environmental Studies All Gauchos Reunion event, and Environmental Studies anniversary celebrations. Responsibilities include reserving venues, coordinating event catering and logistics, assisting the Financial team with organizing event expenses, sending invitations, managing RSVPs, organizing printed programs and certificates, and managing day-of event operations and staff support. Under the general supervision of the Business Officer, manages the Environmental Studies Program website (es.ucsb.edu), the IPEES website (ipees.ucsb.edu), the Environmental Studies Program LinkedIn page, and the Environmental Studies Instagram account by updating content & profiles, uploading photos, and coordinating with our UCSB's Letters & Science Information Technology (LSIT) department for high-level web changes. Ability to learn our basic web Content Management System (currently using Drupal). Utilizes UC Santa Barbara branding on all web and social media updates. Stays up-to-date with web and UCSB branding updates. Produces, edits, designs and publishes annual departmental communications. Promotes the program's visual identity by utilizing campus branding standards and creating visual media such as invitations, flyers, brochures and presentations.
10% Chair’s Assistant - Serves as the primary administrative assistant to the Department Chair. Provides direct assistance on special projects, administrative initiatives, and confidential tasks as assigned by the Department Chair. Project focus primarily on alumni relations and development activities.
5% Back-up Financial Assistance - Provides back-up financial support in coordination with the department's Finance Team. Assists with Concur Travel & Entertainment reimbursements as needed. Assists with departmental purchasing as needed. In coordination with the Finance Team, works on ensuring separation of duties and keeping proper financial controls, records and procedures in place. Assists in preparing reports/financial documentation as needed.

jobs.description:
Join the forefront of groundbreaking research at the Beckman Research Institute of City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. Our dedicated and compassionate faculty and staff are driven by a common mission: Contribute to innovative approaches in predicting, preventing, and curing diseases, shaping the future of medicine through cutting-edge research.

We are looking for an Administrative Program Coordinator to support the research activities within the Beckman Research Institute and the National Medical Center. You will provide high‑level administrative, programmatic, and operational support to senior faculty leadership and departmental programs. The position performs a broad range of complex, diversified, and confidential administrative duties requiring independent judgment, discretion, and a high degree of professionalism. Your responsibilities will include executive calendar and meeting management, coordination of research and academic programs, faculty affairs and recruitment support, financial and business operations assistance, and liaison with internal and external stakeholders.

This role requires exceptional organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, research‑intensive environment. You will serve as a key partner to faculty leadership by anticipating needs, streamlining workflows, and ensuring administrative, compliance, and operational processes are executed efficiently and in alignment with institutional policies. The position requires flexibility, strong communication skills, and the ability to work independently while contributing to the overall success of the department and institution.

You will be responsible for:

Providing high-level administrative support to senior faculty leadership, managing complex calendars, confidential communications, competing priorities, and daily operational needs.
Coordinating and administering research, academic, and departmental programs, including faculty recruitment, onboarding/offboarding of scholars and staff, and logistics for meetings, seminars, symposiums, and special events.
Supporting business operations through budget tracking, purchasing, expense reconciliation, travel coordination, account monitoring, and compliance with institutional and grant funding requirements.
Managing faculty affairs and HR-related processes, including appointments, promotions, effort reporting, visa and Global Scholars Program coordination, and employee lifecycle administration.
Serving as a key liaison for internal and external stakeholders, supporting communications, recruitment outreach, collaboration efforts, and maintenance of faculty CVs, biosketches, publications, and research metrics.
Maintaining departmental records, websites, reports, shared databases, and office operations, ensuring accurate information management, efficient workflows, and seamless facility and visitor coordination.

Bachelor’s degree. Equivalent experience may substitute for minimum education requirements.
3 or more years of experience in business administration, clinical research or healthcare environment

Description

Amazon's Transportation Operations Management (TOM) Central Programs org is driving change in the Middle Mile. The TOM PMO & Analytics team is looking for a Data Analyst to work within the Analytic Insights team to help drive data-driven decision-making, measurement, and reporting across TOM operations. In this role, you would be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing dashboards, metrics, and analytical solutions that support operational improvements and stakeholder needs across the organization. The TOM PMO & Analytics team delivers best-in-class centralized management of metrics, reporting, data quality, and analytical insights to drive TOM in-yard operational improvements across the Middle Mile.

Key job responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports using Amazon QuickSight and other BI tools to support TOM operational metrics and leadership reporting
Analyze large-scale transportation operations datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for operational improvement
Partner with program managers and operational stakeholders to define KPIs, establish measurement frameworks, and ensure consistent metric accountability
Develop and automate data pipelines, ETL processes, and reporting workflows to improve data accuracy and reduce manual effort
Implement and maintain AI-powered tools and automation to streamline data intake triage, stakeholder reporting, and operational analytics
Perform root cause analysis on metric variances and present findings with actionable recommendations to leadership
Ensure data integrity and quality across TOM dashboards by defining and enforcing data standards and validation processes
Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) and other leadership mechanisms by preparing data-driven insights and variance callouts
Collaborate cross-functionally with various teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
Create and maintain documentation for data sources, metric definitions, data lineage, and standard operating procedures

About The Team

The TOM Program & Data Analytics team integrates strategic program management with analytics transformation across three pillars: 1. Program Execution — Drives end-to-end ownership of metric improvement, product development, and CPI initiatives from concept to measurable impact. 2. Change Management & Strategic Communication — Governs review, approval, and adoption of changes to standard work, policy, pilots, and proposals while aligning stakeholders through strategic communications. 3. Data & Analytics Insights — Ensures teams operate from accurate, timely metrics to identify gaps, measure progress, and make data-informed decisions. Together, these pillars enable TOM to execute programs, govern change, and run the business with data.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Knowledge of a modern programming language (Ruby, Java, Python, or C#)
Experience using data to drive root cause elimination and process improvement
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements

Experience with Asana Project Management Platform, or proven experience with a similar intake and project management tool
Experience in transportation or supply chain
Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau

Position Description

The City of Rochester welcomes applications for

GIS Specialist

Rochester Public Utilities

www.rpu.org

The City of Rochester is committed to a community where all members feel a sense of belonging. We commit to recognizing the diversity of our community members, listening to ALL
voices and providing equitable services to create an inclusive place to live, play and work.

We believe EQUITY
should be at the center of all our work. We strive to represent our community in our teammates, as we know that diverse and inclusive teams are more innovative, and have an empowering impact on the work, progress and culture of our community.

It takes us all working together

Nature of Work

This position develops, operates, and maintains enterprise GIS data, applications, and workflows. The GIS Specialist independently scopes and delivers assigned GIS solutions; performs spatial and database analysis; develops and maintains GIS applications and datasets; tests and documents technical work; supports users; and collaborates with internal staff, and partners. Work is performed using organizational standards and may include water, electric, infrastructure, field mobility, asset management, and other enterprise GIS applications.

Work Schedule
- The typical work schedule 8 AM - 5 PM Monday through Friday. Remote work is available up to two days a week after the first 6 months.

Pay
- The 2026 starting salary range is $85,632-$100,743 with advancement to $125,929.

Benefits
- This position is eligible for benefits offered by the City of Rochester. Please review the benefits tab at the top of the page for more details. Employees, whose new position with the City requires they relocate more than 50 miles, are eligible for relocation assistance, pursuant to City policy.

To have your application considered for the first round of interviews, please apply by Wednesday, October 7th, 2026, at 11:59 PM CST.

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

The City of Rochester will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position including F1 OPT STEM.

Duties And Responsibilities

The work below is representative of the scope of work performed within this job classification. Individual job duties will vary based on work assignment . Support GIS administration and related technology.

Support GIS plans , systems, and solutions to meet Department needs .
Operate and maintain the enterprise GIS.
Assist in the development and administration of the departmental GIS work plan.
Independently scope, develop, test, document, and deliver assigned GIS applications, workflows, data products, and technical solutions.
Collaborate with customers, departments, and outside agencies to integrate GIS solutions with related systems and business processes.
Develop and maintain GIS applications that enhance efficiency and use of GIS.
Develop, maintain, and administer Department GIS data and databases.
Plan, develop, and administer spatial and attribute data sets.
Create and update public and associated private infrastructure GIS datasets?
Prepare and edit map layers and produce print or electronic maps for Engineering staff and others.?
Apply established policies and procedures for quality control and quality assurance.?
Develop and implement databases and applications for department records.?
Perform database administration, design SQL queries and perform data entry?
Support utility infrastructure management using field inventory data.?
Prepare and maintain documentation of data sources, database designs, data flows, and dataset metadata.
Test data processes and database changes; document results and coordinate implementation according to established change-management practices.
Provide public service to consultants, developers, citizens, and other agencies.
Work with other departments and governmental offices in developing and maintaining GIS databases for multiple users.
Respond to inquiries and requests for information about Department infrastructure.
Coordinate with other governmental GIS groups.
Prepare technical information for Boards, Councils, City staff agencies, Commissions, neighborhood groups, and professional organizations.
Provide training, guidance and technical support and provide guidance to department and division personnel on GIS, cartographic design, or other mapping requirements.
Provide training and technical support to internal GIS customers and other users of GIS data and applications.
Share technical knowledge, project status, risks, and dependencies with GIS team members so assigned solutions can be supported during staff absences and transitions.
Assist in developing budgets and schedules involving GIS applications, computer hardware and software.
Update, modify and expand GIS related sites including the ArcGIS Enterprise Portal.
Assist with hardware maintenance, software installation and maintenance, and troubleshoot system problems.

Perform Other Related Duties As Assigned

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in geographic information systems (GIS) or related field such as geography, planning, civil engineering, or computer science, with an emphasis in GIS coursework and training; AND three (3) years of full-time employment experience with geographic information systems mapping and database management using ESRI ArcGIS software or its equivalent

OR

An equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job may also be considered.

If this work interests you but you are unsure if you meet all the job requirements listed above, please apply anyway! Your experience is likely more applicable to the role than you think, and the City is interested in candidates who can bring not only technical expertise but a variety of lived experience to the team.

Licenses and Certifications

Valid MN driver's license

Desirable Qualifications

Windows operating systems and Microsoft Office programs
Python programming skills
SQL Server database administration
ArcGIS Enterprise (Pro, Portal, Server) experience
Editing Utility Network data and branch versioning experience
Experience with mapping and/or survey grade GPS units
Experience with Schneider Electric’s ArcFM, Designer, Responder, and Fiber Manager Products

Additional Information

PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL CRITERIA

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the following represents the physical and environmental demands for this position. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions with or without accommodation.

In consideration of the overall amount of physical effort required to perform this position, the work is best described as Sedentary Work : Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Physical demands
that may be required continuously (2/3 or more of the time), frequently (1/3 to 2/3 of the time), and occasionally (up to 1/3 of the time) are noted below:

Continuous demands: sitting

Frequent demands: fine dexterity

Occasional demands: standing, walking, climbing, balancing, reaching, kneeling, crouching, crawling

Sensory requirements
necessary in the performance of the essential functions of this position include: sight, hearing, touch, taste and smell

Environmental conditions

Work is primarily performed indoors with no exposure to temperatures and external elements. Occasionally, work may be required outdoors and subject to the following factors:

Extreme cold (below 32 degrees)

Extreme heat (above 100 degrees)

Work outdoors (no effective protection from weather)

Work at heights (such as on scaffolding or ladders)

Walk on uneven ground (gravel, rocks, mounds, construction sites)

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to help drive better business decisions through thoughtful analysis, clear metric definitions, and strong cross-functional partnership. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to answer high-impact business questions, turn ambiguity into structured analysis, and uncover insights that shape strategy.

This role combines business-impact analytics with hands-on analytical data modeling. You’ll help build and maintain clean, reliable data models and transformations that support scalable reporting, trustworthy metrics, and informed decision-making. You’ll join a small, high-impact data team where ownership is meaningful and your work directly influences company growth.

## Key Responsibilities

* Partner cross-functionally to define KPIs, answer strategic questions, and support business decision-making.
* Build reporting and dashboards that drive action rather than simply monitor performance.
* Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Define, document, and maintain core business metrics to ensure consistency across teams.
* Support and improve dimensional data models, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.
* Build and maintain reliable data transformations that improve data accuracy and consistency.
* Help establish and improve data quality, documentation, and reporting standards.
* Contribute to forecasting, experimentation analysis, and predictive or inference modeling initiatives.
* Work with Product, Engineering, Operations, and GTM teams to define and report on relevant business metrics.
* Help improve the company’s analytical data foundation as the organization grows.

## Required Qualifications

* 2–4 years of professional experience in a Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or similar analytics role.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with a modern cloud data warehouse.
* Experience performing exploratory analysis and translating findings into actionable business insights.

* Experience driving measurable business impact through analytics.
* Experience building analytical data models, not only dashboards and ad hoc reports.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex datasets, analysis, and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proactive mindset with willingness to take ownership of projects and work outside your immediate area of expertise.
* Familiarity with data ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, Stitch, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with dbt, SQLMesh, Dataform, or similar data transformation tools.
* Familiarity with modern BI tools such as Tableau, Sigma, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with version-controlled analytics workflows.
* Understanding of dimensional modeling concepts, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.
* Proficiency in SQL is required.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or another related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience building predictive or inference models.
* Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines.
* Experience implementing data quality testing and documentation practices.
* Experience working with GTM teams to define and report on GTM metrics.
* Exposure to event-based or product analytics data.
* Experience using AI effectively as part of an analytics workflow.
* Experience with modern analytics tooling and cloud data platforms.
* Experience contributing to forecasting, experimentation, or advanced analytical initiatives.

The current analytics environment includes:

* Airbyte
* BigQuery
* SQLMesh
* Looker Studio
* Modern BI and analytics tools
* Version-controlled analytics workflows
* Dimensional data modeling

## What This Role Is Not

* This is not a dashboard-only reporting role.
* This is not a pure data engineering position focused on building production infrastructure.
* This is not a purely reactive analytics role; proactive thinking and ownership are valued.
* This is not an isolated role; collaboration with Product, Engineering, Operations, and other teams is an important part of the position.

As the company grows, a strong analytics foundation is increasingly important for product decisions, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes. This role helps ensure that business metrics are trustworthy, analytical models are scalable, and decisions are supported by structured and defensible analysis.

This position develops, operates, and maintains enterprise GIS data, applications, and workflows. The GIS Specialist independently scopes and delivers assigned GIS solutions; performs spatial and database analysis; develops and maintains GIS applications and datasets; tests and documents technical work; supports users; and collaborates with internal staff, and partners. - The typical work schedule 8 AM - 5 PM Monday through Friday. Remote work is available up to two days a week after the first 6 months.

- This position is eligible for benefits offered by the City of Rochester. Please review the benefits tab at the top of the page for more details. Employees, whose new position with the City requires they relocate more than 50 miles, are eligible for relocation assistance, pursuant to City policy.

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

The City of Rochester will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position including F1 OPT STEM.

Duties And Responsibilities

The work below is representative of the scope of work performed within this job classification. Individual job duties will vary based on work assignment . Support GIS administration and related technology.

Support GIS plans , systems, and solutions to meet Department needs .
Operate and maintain the enterprise GIS.
Assist in the development and administration of the departmental GIS work plan.
Independently scope, develop, test, document, and deliver assigned GIS applications, workflows, data products, and technical solutions.
Collaborate with customers, departments, and outside agencies to integrate GIS solutions with related systems and business processes.
Develop and maintain GIS applications that enhance efficiency and use of GIS.
Develop, maintain, and administer Department GIS data and databases.
Plan, develop, and administer spatial and attribute data sets.
Create and update public and associated private infrastructure GIS datasets?
Prepare and edit map layers and produce print or electronic maps for Engineering staff and others.?

Provide public service to consultants, developers, citizens, and other agencies.
Work with other departments and governmental offices in developing and maintaining GIS databases for multiple users.
Respond to inquiries and requests for information about Department infrastructure.
Coordinate with other governmental GIS groups.
Prepare technical information for Boards, Councils, City staff agencies, Commissions, neighborhood groups, and professional organizations.
Provide training, guidance and technical support and provide guidance to department and division personnel on GIS, cartographic design, or other mapping requirements.
Provide training and technical support to internal GIS customers and other users of GIS data and applications.
Share technical knowledge, project status, risks, and dependencies with GIS team members so assigned solutions can be supported during staff absences and transitions.
Assist in developing budgets and schedules involving GIS applications, computer hardware and software.
Update, modify and expand GIS related sites including the ArcGIS Enterprise Portal.
Assist with hardware maintenance, software installation and maintenance, and troubleshoot system problems.

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in geographic information systems (GIS) or related field such as geography, planning, civil engineering, or computer science, with an emphasis in GIS coursework and training; AND three (3) years of full-time employment experience with geographic information systems mapping and database management using ESRI ArcGIS software or its equivalent

OR

An equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job may also be considered.

Your experience is likely more applicable to the role than you think, and the City is interested in candidates who can bring not only technical expertise but a variety of lived experience to the team.

Valid MN driver's license

Desirable Qualifications

Windows operating systems and Microsoft Office programs
Python programming skills
SQL Server database administration
ArcGIS Enterprise (Pro, Portal, Server) experience
Editing Utility Network data and branch versioning experience
Experience with mapping and/or survey grade GPS units
Experience with Schneider Electric’s ArcFM, Designer, Responder, and Fiber Manager Products

Additional Information

In consideration of the overall amount of physical effort required to perform this position, the work is best described as Sedentary Work : Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. necessary in the performance of the essential functions of this position include: sight, hearing, touch, taste and smell

Work is primarily performed indoors with no exposure to temperatures and external elements. Occasionally, work may be required outdoors and subject to the following factors:

Extreme cold (below 32 degrees)

Extreme heat (above 100 degrees)

Work at heights (such as on scaffolding or ladders)

Walk on uneven ground (gravel, rocks, mounds, construction sites)

Amazon's Transportation Operations Management (TOM) Central Programs org is driving change in the Middle Mile. The TOM PMO & Analytics team is looking for a Data Analyst to work within the Analytic Insights team to help drive data-driven decision-making, measurement, and reporting across TOM operations. In this role, you would be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing dashboards, metrics, and analytical solutions that support operational improvements and stakeholder needs across the organization. The TOM PMO & Analytics team delivers best-in-class centralized management of metrics, reporting, data quality, and analytical insights to drive TOM in-yard operational improvements across the Middle Mile.

Key job responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports using Amazon QuickSight and other BI tools to support TOM operational metrics and leadership reporting

Perform root cause analysis on metric variances and present findings with actionable recommendations to leadership
Ensure data integrity and quality across TOM dashboards by defining and enforcing data standards and validation processes

Collaborate cross-functionally with various teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions

Program Execution — Drives end-to-end ownership of metric improvement, product development, and CPI initiatives from concept to measurable impact. 2. Data & Analytics Insights — Ensures teams operate from accurate, timely metrics to identify gaps, measure progress, and make data-informed decisions. Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements

## About the Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to help drive better business decisions through thoughtful analysis, clear metric definitions, and strong cross-functional partnership. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to answer high-impact business questions, turn ambiguity into structured analysis, and uncover insights that shape strategy.

This role combines business-impact analytics with hands-on analytical data modeling. You’ll help build and maintain clean, reliable data models and transformations that support scalable reporting, trustworthy metrics, and informed decision-making. You’ll join a small, high-impact data team where ownership is meaningful and your work directly influences company growth.

## Key Responsibilities

* Partner cross-functionally to define KPIs, answer strategic questions, and support business decision-making.
* Build reporting and dashboards that drive action rather than simply monitor performance.
* Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Define, document, and maintain core business metrics to ensure consistency across teams.
* Support and improve dimensional data models, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.
* Build and maintain reliable data transformations that improve data accuracy and consistency.
* Help establish and improve data quality, documentation, and reporting standards.
* Contribute to forecasting, experimentation analysis, and predictive or inference modeling initiatives.
* Work with Product, Engineering, Operations, and GTM teams to define and report on relevant business metrics.
* Help improve the company’s analytical data foundation as the organization grows.

## Required Qualifications

* 2–4 years of professional experience in a Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or similar analytics role.

* Experience performing exploratory analysis and translating findings into actionable business insights.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence business stakeholders through data.
* Experience driving measurable business impact through analytics.
* Experience building analytical data models, not only dashboards and ad hoc reports.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex datasets, analysis, and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proactive mindset with willingness to take ownership of projects and work outside your immediate area of expertise.
* Familiarity with data ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, Stitch, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with dbt, SQLMesh, Dataform, or similar data transformation tools.
* Familiarity with modern BI tools such as Tableau, Sigma, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with version-controlled analytics workflows.
* Understanding of dimensional modeling concepts, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.
* Proficiency in SQL is required.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or another related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience building predictive or inference models.
* Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines.
* Experience implementing data quality testing and documentation practices.
* Experience working with GTM teams to define and report on GTM metrics.
* Exposure to event-based or product analytics data.
* Experience using AI effectively as part of an analytics workflow.
* Experience with modern analytics tooling and cloud data platforms.

The current analytics environment includes:

* Airbyte

* SQLMesh

* This is not a dashboard-only reporting role.
* This is not a pure data engineering position focused on building production infrastructure.
* This is not a purely reactive analytics role; proactive thinking and ownership are valued.

As the company grows, a strong analytics foundation is increasingly important for product decisions, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes. new_jobs.description:
Overview

With over 50 years of proven success, ECG, ranked as a Best Midsized Firm to Work For 2026 by Consulting Magazine , is the most experienced healthcare consulting firm in the US. Across our seven office locations, we’re seeking individuals who will show the courage to find innovative solutions and make a direct impact on the delivery of healthcare services nationwide.

About ECG

ECG is a national consulting firm that is redefining healthcare together with its clients. We provide a broad range of strategic, financial, operational, and technology-enabled consulting services to the full continuum of care, including hospitals, health systems, medical groups, academic medical centers, children’s hospitals, cancer centers, ambulatory surgery centers, investors, and payers/health plans.

Our work focuses on creating practical, tailored solutions that help clients maximize resources and achieve sustainable results. We value collaboration, integrity, and innovation, and are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment.

Job Details

Join Our Analytics Hub

Our growing Analytics Hub works with our consulting teams to deliver new insights, streamlined analysis, and world-class intelligence to the healthcare organizations we serve as clients. Combined with our consulting teams, you will be helping physician and executive leadership make informed decisions that can alter the course of their enterprises in areas such as physician alignment, mergers and acquisitions, service line planning, provider compensation, financial performance, transforming care models, patient access, managed care portfolio optimization, digital health expansion, and more. ECG uses a Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment, with Microsoft Power BI as ECG’s current analytics visualization platform.

Our detailed plans incorporate qualitative findings with data-driven strategic, operational, and financial considerations that enable organizations to pursue realistic change. Our consultants bridge the gap between strategic thinking and operational implementation with sensible action plans and tactical recommendations. This approach allows us to stretch our clients’ thinking while ensuring that initiatives with the broadest and deepest impact are prioritized and implementable. Our wide-ranging engagements often focus on helping our clients:

Position themselves for value-based care delivery.
Align hospitals and physician organizations.
Strengthen financial performance.
Enhance clinical programs.
Develop strategic partnerships and/or mergers.

Your Opportunity with ECG: Senior Data Analyst

As a senior data analyst, you will support the firm’s client delivery and business development efforts, working with consultants and senior leaders to manage large datasets, aggregate internal and external data, develop scalable models and other analyses, and support data visualization and presentation sets. In addition, the analyst will work directly with our internal support teams (IT, business development, and L&D) and associated vendors for data management and IT solutions and will assist with a range of innovative analytic opportunities. Here, no two days or projects are alike, which means you’ll have a lot to learn and plenty of support to help you succeed.

Your Responsibilities May Include

Gather and synthesize data from various sources (e.g., national surveys, proprietary research, client interviews, industries, markets).
Prepare analyses related to hospital inpatient databases and provider claims data.
Build flexible, dynamic, and scalable financial and operational models to forecast trends, preparing scenarios for consulting efforts related to delivery and business development (e.g., strategic planning, operational improvement, market assessments).
Enhance existing models and capabilities built using SQL, primarily, with some use of Python or R in certain models or scenarios.
Perform complex analyses on big data, including cleaning, preparing, and interpreting.
Identify and execute analyses in response to consultant business intelligence inquiries.
Build relational databases using a Microsoft SQL Server or Fabric.
Communicate market insights to pursuit teams, and support business development efforts.
Configure, maintain, and build flexible reports, queries, and visuals within the Power BI environment and the production and development environments of related databases.
Research, test, and implement solutions in Power BI.
Partner with various consulting units (Strategy & Enterprise Growth, Payer Strategy & Contracting, Health System Performance, and Medical Group Optimization) to gather requirements related to data analytics.
Develop, configure, and maintain interfaces to exchange data among Power BI, SQL databases, and other cloud-based applications.
Create and maintain analytical support documentation and operating procedures.
Develop new and innovative methodologies and approaches.
Contribute to internal education and learning opportunities for consultants and operations members for the Analytics Hub and analytics in general, and support education about ECG’s use cases related to analytics.
Assist the vice president of data analytics and AI in developing analytics and data strategy to support data analytics capabilities at the firm.

Qualifications

Strong knowledge of and passion for the healthcare industry
A bachelor’s degree in either computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, statistics, health information management, or a related degree that relies heavily on critical thinking, logic, and math
5+ years of experience in healthcare data analytics, including analyzing clinical, operational, financial, or population health data
Experience in healthcare consulting, healthcare technology, or working for a hospital or health system, using data to deliver actionable insights and recommendations
Strong proficiency in data analysis, reporting, dashboard development, and translating complex data into actionable business insights
Experience working with healthcare datasets such as claims, EHRs, patient outcomes, quality metrics, or value-based care programs is highly preferred
Advanced skills in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI); experience with Python, R, Databricks, or Azure is a plus
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Excellent organizational skills

Job Locations

Preferred locations: Chicago or Washington, DC
Other location: Boston

Schedule

Full time/exempt

What You Can Expect Of Us

To reward our driven, innovative, and passionate employees, we’ve built a company culture that’s centered on performance. We offer an attractive compensation package, challenging work, and an entrepreneurial environment where you can take ownership of your career—and get out as much as you put in.

The estimated base salary range for this job is $100000.00 - $130000.00 annually. It represents a good faith estimate of the range that ECG reasonably expects to pay at the time of the job posting.
